title: The values of the Hermite constants for dimensions other than 1–8 and 24
exact_target: Determine the exact Hermite constants outside dimensions one through eight and twenty-four. The cited version supplies the value two in dimension nine.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7200067 (AMR-071-0067). CC BY 4.0.
Mathieu Dutour Sikirić and Wessel van Woerden, The lattice packing problem in dimension 9 by Voronoi’s algorithm (arXiv:2508.20719v2, 2026). Section 1, Corollary 1, and Section 2.1, pp. 1–4.
